title: withdrawal.requested
description: A user has asked to withdraw. Nothing is held and nothing is signed yet: the request has only been recorded, and the chain role decides it against the withdrawal policy next.

withdrawal_id.description: Stable id of the withdrawal across every event about it.

amount.description: Decimal amount in the asset's own units, never wei.

to_address.description: The destination the user asked for, lower-case.

chain_id.description: EVM chain the withdrawal will be sent on.

status.description: The withdrawal's status after this event. An open string: the state machine grows with the signer, and a new state must not break a consumer.

previous_status.description: What the withdrawal moved away from. Absent on withdrawal.requested, which has no previous state.

reason.description: Why it went where it did: a policy reason, a review note, or a failure reason. Absent when there is nothing to explain.
